question: Pipes A and B can fill a rectangular tank in 40 minutes and 120 minutes, respectively. Pipe C can empty the completely filled same tank in 240 minutes. If pipes A, B and C are opened at the same time, then how many minutes will it take to fill the tank?
solution:

Pipe A fills the tank in 40 minutes

s the tank in 120 minutes

**Formula used:**
